title: Mobile Pet Salon & Spa, Dog & Cat Cuts & Styling | Northeast Dallas TX

facts.fact: Zoomin Groomin states that most of its mobile grooming appointments last between 1 and 2 hours, depending on pet size, breed, and coat condition.
facts.quote: Most appointments last between 1 to 2 hours, depending on the size, breed, and condition of your pet's coat.

facts.fact: Zoomin Groomin lists 214-831-9910 as its phone number for Northeast Dallas.
Zoomin Groomin states that nail trimming, ear cleaning, and teeth cleaning are included with every service.
facts.quote: Nail trimming, ear cleaning, and teeth cleaning Included with every service, ensuring full pet care.

facts.fact: Zoomin Groomin states that it primarily grooms dogs and cats of all breeds, sizes, and ages.
facts.quote: We primarily groom dogs and cats of all breeds, sizes, and ages — including seniors and special-needs pets.

facts.fact: Zoomin Groomin states that a pet parent or guardian must be home at the start of each appointment to greet the groomer and pet.
facts.quote: Yes, we ask that a pet parent or guardian is home at the beginning of the appointment to greet the groomer and your pet.

facts.fact: Zoomin Groomin states that its mobile grooming vans are self-contained with their own water supply and power system, so customers do not need to provide water or electricity.
facts.quote: Our mobile grooming vans are fully self-contained with their own water supply and power system.

facts.fact: Zoomin Groomin states that all grooming is done in a cage-free environment with one pet and one groomer per appointment.
facts.quote: Never. All grooming takes place in a quiet, cage-free environment — just one pet, one groomer, and lots of gentle care.
